title: Exporting for Windows
key_points: Godot offers a way to export projects for PC distribution using the export system.
The exporter creates a data.pck file that is bundled with an optimized binary.
Three processor architectures are supported: x86_64, x86_32, and arm64.
PCK embedding is only supported for executables up to ~3.89 GB in size.
Godot can perform automatic code signing on export using a package signing certificate.
limitations: x86_32 option should not be used unless trying to target old 32bit versions of Windows.
arm64 executable will not run on regular x86_64 processors.
PCK embedding size limit may vary based on build options using a custom export template.
asserts: Godot provides an elegant approach for PC distribution when exporting projects, with support for different processor architectures and the ability to embed PCK files and perform code signing.
scope: The document explains how to use Godot's export system to create Windows executables for PC distribution, covering architecture options, PCK embedding, changing executable icons, code signing, and environment variables.
